description: Hovering a pinned launcher with no running window shows a text tooltip while the preview popup content remains hidden.

assertions.comment: The hovered target is a launcher-only item with no running window.
The text tooltip background at the unnamed fixed child path is eventually visible after hovering.
The tooltip show state is enabled in the launcher-only branch.
The tooltip Label at the unnamed fixed child path shows only the launcher name.

The unique child path absent from DockView confirms that the preview popup content Column is hidden. Marked invariant: hovering an item must not open the preview surface. The discriminator is the preview scenarios, where a hover on a running window does open it.

The preview QQuickView surface always exists, but hovering a launcher does not create a new popup window. Marked invariant: hovering an item must not open the preview surface. The discriminator is the preview scenarios, where a hover on a running window does open it.
